speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling your heart beating slowly or irregularly?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't really noticed my heart beating slowly or irregularly, but I do get tired just sitting in my chair. My voice also sounds a bit raspy lately, even after drinking water. speaker: Doctor
text:
That is an interesting contradiction in the records, but given the physician's direct instruction not to order further tests, I will proceed based on the classic triad of symptoms you have presented: fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance.
